simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פֶּתֶן (H6620) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פֶּתֶן (pethen) means an asp (from its contortions ) First listed occurrence: Deut 32 33.

definitions.full: H6620. pethen מֶּ֫תֶן noun masculine Psa 68:5 a venomous serpent , perhaps cobra ( פתן Ecclus 39:30; Aramaic מִּתְנָא , , whence perhaps Arabic ; — only in poetry: plural ראֹשׁ מְּתָנִים Deut 32:33 (|| תַּנִּינִם חֲמַת ), Job 20:16 , פ ׳מְרוֺרַת 20:14 ; singular מֶּ֫תֶן Psa 91:13 (|| תַּנִּין ), ׳פ חֵרֵשׁ 58:5 , מָּ֑תֶן חֻר Isa 11:8 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to twist ;
